title: Dataset overview
description: Load the curated host-pathogen dataset and summarise pathogens, effectors and host targets.

title: Survival-strategy classifier
description: Train and cross-validate the Random Forest that predicts a pathogen's intracellular survival strategy.

title: Effector sequence features
description: Compute 450 sequence features per effector and inspect coverage of the resolved UniProt set.

title: Host-pathogen network analysis
description: Build the effector/host-protein network and compute centrality and community metrics.

title: Novel findings (feature vs strategy)
description: Welch's t-tests with Benjamini-Hochberg FDR control comparing sequence features across survival strategies.
